decisionnode-flash-0.9.1-rc1.disclosure: Hosted API by Bynn, measured directly through the vendor's synchronous endpoint. All 1,500 items were sent; 5 items over the provider's input limit were refused (HTTP 400 max_tokens_exceeded), scored as misses and kept in the denominator. The provider reports probabilities to two decimals; exact zeros on many-option items are expected, and Calibration is computed on the reported values without adjustment. Output tokens reported as 0. Measured on the 27 Oct 2026 regular draw, not yet equated to the reference scale (offset 0). This draw has no subject-topic labels yet; use-case and language cells are measured on its own draw. Latency: p50 0.256 s, p95 0.317 s, maximum 0.668 s.
